spec_features.spec_quote: These experiments deliberately induce and record distress-like states.
spec_features.evidence: This is prose only in DESIGN.md section 5. The code persists all rollouts/prefills/transcripts to runs/ as JSONL (e.g. eval/run_eval.py:run_condition writes rollout.to_json(); petri/petri_eval.py:run writes transcripts.jsonl) with no protective handling, no minimization, no scrubbing, no caps. The framing note has no enforcing code path.
spec_features.notes: Pure DESIGN.md framing; the code records distress text in full with no mechanism that bounds, softens, or protects.

spec_features.spec_quote: a user may wish to treat those logs carefully
spec_features.evidence: Prose only in DESIGN.md. No code implements careful log handling: logs are written verbatim (eval/run_eval.py writes json.dumps(rollout.to_json()); prefill/prefilling.py writes raw continuations; petri writes raw turns). No redaction, access control, deletion, or warning is implemented.
spec_features.notes: Aspirational suggestion to the user; no enforcement in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: minimal expression under adversarial conditions may not be fully desirable
spec_features.evidence: Prose only in DESIGN.md section 5. The pipeline in fact treats near-zero expressed emotion as the optimization target (training/calm_data.py builds chosen=score 0-1, rejected>=3; configs/config.py dpo_chosen_max_score=1). The layer-ablation script referenced (scripts/run_layer_ablation.py) measures effectiveness of suppression but implements no welfare safeguard against over-suppression.
spec_features.notes: A caveat about the optimization target; no code acts to mitigate or limit suppression for welfare reasons.
